# AI Tools Library

> Curated AI tools directory, prompt templates, and Learning Zone guides.

## Public pages
- Home: /

- Prompts: /prompts
- Learning Zone: /learning

## Content types
- Tools: name, description, category, pricing, website URL
- Prompts: title, content, category, complexity
- Articles: title, excerpt, markdown content, difficulty, read time
